17.name: Operational Export & Interoperability

export-contract-models.evidence: Canonical export contract and normalized models implemented for Test Cases, Coverage Review, Regression Analysis, and export metadata.

canonical-parsers.evidence: Strict canonical parsers validated current testcase, coverage, and regression semantics without silently accepting legacy representations.

generic-export.evidence: Generic XLSX/CSV export implemented with human-readable headers, deterministic column order, multiline testcase steps, filtering, freeze panes, and usable column widths.

integrity-validation.evidence: Round-trip/integrity validation reconciles exported rows, identifiers, headers, semantic values, and regression tier membership against canonical Markdown sources.

generic-profile.evidence: Verified generic interoperability profile preserves canonical semantics while keeping normalized model keys separate from human-readable spreadsheet rendering.

operational-pilot-final-gate.evidence: My Rewards 3.0 pilot exported 63 Test Cases plus current Coverage Review and Regression Analysis; legacy artifacts were correctly rejected, current artifacts validated, spreadsheet usability findings were fixed, Human QC approved, and final repository validation passed.

17.scope: Provide deterministic operational export of canonical QA-AI artifacts to interoperable spreadsheet/tabular representations without making exports authoritative or weakening canonical semantics.
17.freeze_evidence: Human QC confirmed PASS on 2026-08-18 after the My Rewards 3.0 operational export pilot and full deterministic validation.

18.name: Test Execution & Defect Feedback
18.scope: Establish deterministic test execution evidence, canonical result statuses, run lifecycle, defect/evidence linkage, retest history, current disposition, summary reconciliation, and provenance without taking ownership of external defect workflow or automated execution.
exit_criteria: Canonical execution run/result/defect-link models and schemas are defined.
Run and result lifecycle preserve immutable execution history and testcase provenance.
Blocked results require an explicit blocker type and reason and remain distinct from Fail.
Defect and evidence references remain traceable without redefining external defect lifecycle.
Retest records preserve prior failures and current disposition is deterministic.
Execution summaries reconcile exactly with unique scoped testcase IDs.
Stale testcase execution is guarded and any override is explicit and auditable.
A controlled operational pilot demonstrates Pass, Fail, Blocked, Not Applicable, defect linkage, retest-to-Pass, validation, and Human QC usability approval.
Final repository validation passes with no blocking execution-lifecycle issue.
